data.subject: CABO filing and a research pilot
data.body:
Hi — Silver Rock Financial LP’s most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in OPTU, CYH, and CABO.

On October 2, 2026, CABO entered into a material definitive agreement in an 8-K Item 1.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1632127/000095015726001058/form8-k.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
